landing.heroSubtitle: The digital library portal for students of UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta. Borrow, read, and track your collection with ease.
landing.portalDesc: Access the book collection, borrow online, read e-books, and track return status anytime.
landing.feature2: Read e-books directly in your browser
landing.sectionSubtitle: Before signing in, get to know the available features - click one on the left to read the full explanation.

landing.f.borrow.title: Borrow & Return Books Online
landing.f.borrow.summary: Reserve physical books without queuing on site.
landing.f.borrow.detail: Search for available books on the Search Books page, choose a borrowing duration, then confirm your reservation - you'll get a digital proof of loan right away.
landing.f.borrow.step1: Search for available books on the Search Books page
landing.f.borrow.step2: Choose a borrowing duration, then confirm the reservation
landing.f.borrow.step3: Pick up the physical book at the library on schedule
landing.f.borrow.step4: Return it before the due date
landing.f.ebook.title: Read E-books Directly in Your Browser
landing.f.ebook.summary: No extra app needed, no need to visit the library.
landing.f.ebook.detail: Books labeled E-book can be read directly from your browser, anytime, complete with reading comfort settings.
landing.f.ebook.step1: Open the Read menu, choose the e-book you're borrowing
landing.f.ebook.step2: Adjust font size & dark mode to your liking
landing.f.ebook.step3: Bookmark the chapter you're reading, continue anytime
landing.f.ebook.step4: Access ends automatically once the loan period is over
landing.f.history.title: Track Your Borrowing History
landing.f.history.summary: Every activity recorded neatly in one place.
landing.f.history.detail: Every loan, physical book or e-book, is recorded in the My Loans menu with a status that's always clear.
landing.f.history.step2: Check the history of completed loans
landing.f.notif.title: Automatic Due-Date Notifications
landing.f.notif.summary: You'll never forget a return deadline again.
landing.f.notif.detail: The system reminds you through in-app notifications, well before any deadline passes.
landing.f.notif.step1: Automatic reminders as a physical book's due date approaches
landing.f.notif.step2: Alerts when an e-book's borrowing period is about to end
landing.f.notif.step3: Everything collected neatly in the bell icon on the header
landing.f.chat.title: Live Chat with Admin
landing.f.chat.detail: Have questions about operating hours, how to borrow, or account issues? Chat directly from the floating button in the corner of the screen.
landing.f.chat.step1: Click the floating chat button in the corner of the screen
landing.f.chat.step2: Common questions get answered automatically within seconds
landing.f.chat.step3: The library admin follows up on anything more specific
landing.f.chat.step4: Always clear which reply is automatic and which is from a real admin
